items.title: Archer Daniels Q3 Earnings Beat on Biofuel Strength, Revenues Miss
items.summary: ADM's Q3 2026 earnings surge 92.4% on strong biofuel margins and crushing gains, offsetting a revenue miss and prompting a higher full-year earnings outlook.

items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (NASDAQ:KDP) is scheduled to report its earnings on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The company has a market value of about $48.8 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $20.1 billion in revenue and $3.3 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.4 billion.
